verdict.rationale: Open-source license compliance counsel is a fair question for a full-service law firm with IP and technology practices, so the axis applies. However, no evidence names OSS licensing or OSS usage policies as a capability. The IP page covers only trademarks and patents (including patent licensing), and the TMC page covers digital platforms, data and AI generally. These are adjacent practice areas, not the named capability.

support.subject: As a developer, the firm counsels on open-source license compliance and OSS usage policies for product companies, documented as a named capability
